verse.verse_2: Because there came to him the blind man.
verse.verse_3: And how can you know that he might become pure
verse.verse_4: Or he might receive admonition, and the admonition might profit him
verse.verse_5: As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient,
verse.verse_7: What does it matter to you if he will not become pure
verse.verse_8: But as for him who came to you running,
verse.verse_10: Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another.
verse.verse_11: Nay; indeed it is an admonition.
verse.verse_12: So, whoever wills, let him pay attention to Him (it).
verse.verse_17: Qutila mankind! How ungrateful he is!
verse.verse_18: From what thing did He create him
verse.verse_19: From a Nutfah He created him and then set him in due proportion.
verse.verse_20: Then He made the path easy for him.
verse.verse_21: Then He causes him to die and puts him in his grave.
verse.verse_22: Then when it is His will, He will resurrect him.
verse.verse_23: Nay, but has not done what He commanded him.
verse.verse_24: Then let man look at his food:
verse.verse_25: We pour forth water in abundance.
verse.verse_26: And We split the earth in clefts.
verse.verse_27: And We cause therein Habb to grow,
verse.verse_32: A provision and benefit for you and your cattle.
verse.verse_34: That Day shall a man flee from his brother.
verse.verse_35: And from his mother and his father.
verse.verse_36: And from his wife and his children.
verse.verse_37: Every man that Day will have enough to make him careless of others.
verse.verse_38: Some faces that Day will be bright,
verse.verse_40: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained.
verse.verse_42: Such will be the disbelieving, the wicked evil doers.
